methods.fitIntegrity: All six files must pass header CRC, file CRC, whole-file CRC, size and FIT signature checks.
methods.segmentBoundaries: Four efforts have exact matched Strava/FIT timestamp boundaries. Eleven use reviewed metric-reconciled FIT boundaries. Coll de sa Batalla and Santa Llúcia were not ridden because of weather and intentionally have no inferred trace.
methods.segmentSampling: The first range index is a boundary point. Metrics use one-second samples immediately after that boundary through the ending boundary, exactly matching posted elapsed seconds.
methods.power: Explicit zeroes remain zero. Missing instantaneous power is reconstructed only from an exact consecutive one-second accumulated-power delta; unresolved samples remain null.
methods.rollingPower: Arithmetic mean of one-second samples; windows never cross a timestamp gap or unresolved sample.
methods.normalizedPower: Segment NP is a gap-safe 30-second rolling fourth-power approximation using complete 30-second windows only; it can differ slightly from device/platform values.
methods.heartRateDrift: Every ridden segment gets first-versus-second-half HR and power changes. These are descriptive, not proof of fatigue. Power:HR decoupling is shown only for segments at least 20 minutes long.
methods.powerHrDecoupling: 100 × (1 − (second-half power/HR) ÷ (first-half power/HR)); positive means the efficiency ratio declined in the second half.
methods.grade: Chart grade is a centered approximately 100 m altitude slope and never crosses a timestamp gap.
methods.notableEffortThresholds: Editable defaults are 90% of the observed six-ride camp best at each duration, rounded to the nearest 5 W. This is a transparent near-best heuristic, not a physiological zone boundary.
methods.distinctEfforts: All overlapping or touching qualifying rolling windows in one continuous recording run are merged into one bout. The explorer also exposes the maximum count of non-overlapping fixed-duration windows; rolling-start counts are diagnostic and must not be described as effort counts.
methods.editableThresholdEncoding: Per-ride rolling-window files contain every valid one-second start as an exact integer watt-second sum, grouped by timestamp-contiguous run. A client tests sum >= editable threshold × duration and merges overlapping/touching qualifying windows within each run.
methods.fitnessBaseline: Segment intensity uses 250 W FTP and 68 kg. Relative performance uses the best exact same-duration gap-safe power observed anywhere in these six FIT files, not historical Strava data.
methods.privacy: Exports contain no latitude, longitude, activity ID, source filename, file hash or hardware serial.
